subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick confirmation & pre-demo checklist
messages:
From: Alex Wang <alex.wang@cartline.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a hosted API eval — quick demo?

Hi Rafael,

I signed up for the self-serve account yesterday and poked around the Hosted API. Our eng team at Cartline wants a short walkthrough focused on latency/throughput for our invoice extraction workload. Would you have a 30-minute slot tomorrow or Thursday? Prefer afternoon Pacific.

Attendees: me (Alex), Priya Rao (data lead), and one backend engineer.

Thanks — excited to see how Redwood can fit into our stack.

—Alex
Senior Product Manager, Cartline
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@cartline.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a hosted API eval — quick demo?

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up.

I can run a focused 30-minute Hosted API eval covering: perf baseline (latency & throughput), batching/kv-cache tips for invoices, and a quick sandbox run. Tomorrow I have 2:30–3:00pm PT or Thursday 3:30–4:00pm PT. Do either work?

Looping in Mina (SDR) to send the calendar invite and sandbox access. If you can drop a short note about the expected RPS and avg doc size, our demo will be much more practical.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Wang <alex.wang@cartline.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cartline.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a hosted API eval — quick demo?

Thanks Rafael — Thursday 3:30–4:00pm PT works for us.

Quick answers to prep:
- Expected steady-state RPS: 8–12 reqs/s during business hours, burst to ~35 for nightly batch imports.
- Avg document length: ~350 tokens after extraction.
- Priority for the session: end-to-end latency, best batching config, and how caching helps for repeated templates.

Please invite Priya (priya@cartline.com) and our backend engineer (cc'ed on follow-up invite).

—Alex
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@cartline.com>, Priya Rao <priya@cartline.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood Hosted API eval — calendar invite + sandbox access

Hi Alex / Priya — Mina here from Redwood Ops. Rafael confirmed Thursday 3:30–4:00pm PT. I've created a short invite (attached: sandbox-invite.ics) and provisioned a temporary sandbox workspace for Cartline.

Pre-demo checklist (attached as pdf):
- Share one representative invoice sample (anonymized) in the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/Cartline-Prework
- Confirm preferred test route: text-generation (invoice parsing template) or structured output (schema).
- Provide a L1 contact who can join the call for quick API key validation.

Attachments: sandbox-invite.ics, redwood_pre-demo-checklist.pdf

If you need a later time, Diego can help rerun the slot — cc'ing him for flexibility.

Thanks — see you Thursday.
Mina Haddad
SDR — Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wang <alex.wang@cartline.com>, Priya Rao <priya@cartline.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API eval — calendar invite + sandbox access

Perfect — thanks Alex and team. A couple of quick notes so the 30 minutes is high signal:
- Priya: if you can paste one sample invoice into the Drive folder before the session, we'll run a live single-request and one small-batch (5–10 docs) to show tail latency.
- Grace (Customer Success) will join the call to capture follow-ups and next-step checklists for a short pilot.
- I'll share a 1-page perf summary after the session and a recommended batching/kv-cache config tuned to your token sizes.

Looking forward — invite shows as accepted on my calendar.

Best,
Rafael
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pre-demo-checklist.pdf
